entities.summary: Cesare Merzagora was a performers & entertainers in Milan (1898-11-09, Milan – 1991-05-01) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with economic development and trade and geopolitical linkage and diplomacy. Influenced economic patterns and commercial practices.
